title: Tabs: Browser-Style Tab Management for Blender’s Workspace
raw_summary:
Tabs bring web-browser / game-engine-like tabs to Blender. Several editors sharing one area, each keeping its own state. Add, rename, reorder and close them, drag a tab to another area or tear it off into its own window, and lock the ones a layout depends on.

Source
summary_fr: Addon Tabs gestion espace Blender, optimisation workflow UI avec ergonomie browser-like.

- Feature addon sérieuse : amélioration ergonomique substantielle du workflow Blender
- Architecture inspirée UI browser/game-engine : paradigme moderne réduisant friction navigation
- Fonction verrouillage onglets + déplacement/détachement windows : sophistication workflow avancée

- Valeur réelle pour productivité motion designer Blender : gain temps multiplicateur sur longs projets 3D
